segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: Thanks for calling support, this is Maya. Can I get your company name and the last four digits of your account ID?

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Yeah, this is Daniel at Northbridge Materials. Last four are 4187.

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: Got it, thanks. I have the account up in the admin console. What can I help with today?

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: We need to add three user seats for our operations team. Ideally today, if that's simple. We're currently at 42 seats and need to go to 45.

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: Yep, that’s straightforward. I’m checking the billing tool now. You’re on annual billing through March 31, 2026, so the prorated charge for three seats through the end of the term is $1,128.60 before tax.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Okay, that matches what I expected. Can you add them and send the updated invoice to billing@northbridgematerials.com?

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: Yes. I’ve added the three seats, so your limit is now 45. The updated invoice is generated as INV-208944, due September 2, for $1,128.60 plus applicable tax. I’m sending it to that billing address now.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Perfect. Do I need to do anything else for the users to show up?

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: No, you’re all set. Your account admin can invite them from Users, then Add user. The new seats are available immediately.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Great, thanks for the quick help.

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: You’re welcome. I’ll also note this on ticket 784216. Have a good one.
